card.name: Words just before emissions or pollution
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'emissions', 'pollution' or 'by-products' noun in environmental text, such as 'reduces', 'creates', 'emit', 'harmful' and 'VOC'.

modes.label: Verbs of producing or cutting
modes.description: Verbs like reduces, creates or emit that lead into an emissions or pollutant noun.

card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'emissions' or 'pollution' is expected in text about the environmental impact of fuels and industry.
